text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A little while ago, in a certain town, 
lived an ordinary Umamusume named 
O-Machi-chan, whom you could find just 
about anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Working hard as the poster girl for her 
family's wildly popular diner, little 
Machi gets along great with all the 
regulars!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm all smiles eating a meal together with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, wait, no. Seeing everyone eating 
with big smiles makes Machi-chan smile 
too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"As I spent my days like that, one day an 
Umamusume race came on the TV!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's smiles just kept getting 
bigger! And Machi-chan was totally 
thrilled by the race's intensity!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And that is how! Little Machi came to 
yearn for the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I joined a club, trained, took the test, 
and passed, so—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And so, she enrolled in Tracen Academy! 
And they all lived happily ever after!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's it!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it! Pretty ordinary, right? 
My reason for looking up to them is a 
super relatable Umamusume thing, too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I would think that simply managing to 
enroll here already makes you far from 
"ordinary," though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right? Even though it's one of the most 
competitive in all of Japan, pretty much.

A momentous first day to mark our journey 
running through the Twinkle Series 
together.

Her friends—Twin Turbo, an overly 
energetic runaway Umamusume, and Nice 
Nature, an Umamusume with a slightly 
cynical edge.

And so, along with the intellectual 
Umamusume Ikuno Dictus, I came to watch 
the mock races.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
To think Machi is finally making her 
debut, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uhm, Machikane Tannhauser-san! Do you have 
any specific goals for the Twinkle 
Series!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Reporter Nature! Let's see. I want to 
do my absolute best in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is full of races packed 
with strong Umamusume, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Failing to win a graded race is totally 
normal, and only a tiny handful ever win a 
GI race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And in the middle of all that, if you 
start aiming for the Classic Triple Crown 
or winning both the spring and autumn 
Tenno Sho, then geez!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"It means having to win GⅠ races 
back-to-back, when winning even one is 
hard enough as it is!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You really gotta wonder how the Umamusume 
who've won it managed to pull it off, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I get it, I really get it...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's exactly why I kinda want to 
win, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Win... I get that too. I get it, but...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm heading to a competitive stage, 
I just properly and genuinely want to go 
for the win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"So for now, I guess I'll just never give 
up and aim for first place in every single 
race!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ehh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I like that! Turbo's having that too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That way?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Not that! No way, how did you even get to 
that from what we were saying!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I even made a proper plan, see?

With that, Matikane Tannhauser showed her 
notepad to Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you really made one...! You even 
wrote down the meals.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fufun!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man... As always, she's either dreaming 
huge, or she's completely fearless...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, that's what makes her so 
charming, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Chasing grand dreams as if it were the 
most natural thing in the world is not 
something just anyone can do.

As if cutting through their conversation, 
the stands suddenly erupted into 
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: It's started! McQueen and Teio's race!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"All Umamusume are loaded into the 
gates—and they're off!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Teio and McQueen have broken away 
just the two of them, pulling further and 
further ahead!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the idol of all stayers, 
McQueen-san! The sheer intensity is on 
another level~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
People say Teio-san's the main star of 
this year's Classic class, and man, she 
really does feel like a true "genius"~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As expected, those two are a cut above the 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Under 200m remaining! Leaving the rest of 
the pack far behind, it's completely down 
to a one-on-one duel!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Here I go... from here on out! Taaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will not let you! Haaah!
(Waaaaaahhh--!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, what an absolutely incredible 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Honestly though, part of me feels glad 
that I wasn't running..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The girls behind look so gloomy. Well, 
after having such a huge gap in ability 
flaunted before them, can you blame 
them...

The cheers ignited by those geniuses 
carried more than enough heat to send a 
sharp sting through the hearts of 
"ordinary" Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haaah! That was an amazing race! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It truly was a clash of geniuses. It 
was incredible, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's like she didn't even care about the 
other Umamusume at all! Man, it was pure 
genius—sent chills down my spine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If an ordinary person like me were to try 
to beat those two... How should I do it? 
Maybe charge up from behind on the 
straight?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, Teio's acceleration is incredible, 
so if I have to save enough leg to react 
to that...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. Guess we gotta start with physical 
conditioning after all~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...... Most of the time, they chicken out, 
get bitter, or get blinded by all the 
glitter and glamour...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I can just snap into that 
kind of mood right away, y'know~~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I really ought to take a page out 
of your book about that, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Go on ahead without me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaa?! Nature~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh, did I say something that weird?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nay! Nice Nature's point is entirely 
valid! That is one of your greatest 
charms!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to hear your voice while 
on a walk, pure coincidence! Anyway, 
putting that aside—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Truth is, I have high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: E-E-Expectations!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, there are countless Umamusume only 
you can guide! Please, give it everything 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...is what she told me! Ehehe.

This wasn't the first time Chairwoman 
Akikawa had said such words to 
Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Your future is dazzling! I, for one, am 
very much looking forward to what you do 
next!

Whether speaking as the Chairwoman who 
oversees the academy, or simply as 
herself, caring deeply for the Umamusume—

Her true intentions remain unknown, but it 
is certain she has her eye on Machikane 
Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't really understand 
why you have such high hopes for someone 
like me, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, oh well! If they knew about my 
debut, it surely means they've been 
watching over me!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just plain super happy that you're 
keeping an eye on me! Yeah!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've decided! From now on, in 
the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'll do my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right?! Let's give it our all, Trainer!

Putting aside "quite well"... Chairwoman 
Akikawa's expectations seemed to have 
struck a deep chord with her.

And so began our days aiming for victory, 
together with a hard-working, somewhat 
clumsy, yet "ordinary" girl.
